definitions.background: iid binary, independent across (L,seed); same realization across R at fixed L/seed
definitions.s_R: mean owner-tile patch pressure divided by applied pressure; finite-patch diagnostic
definitions.full_wrench: two end forces and moments; local axial/shear/moment columns share the maximum reference full-wrench normalization
definitions.tangent: full geometric element tangent per applied pressure, normalized by max reference coefficient
definitions.limitation: Finite periodic boxes and finite patches; no proof of H2 or H2_infinity.
